jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(5)(A) inventory: Pittsfield School District, a town school district in the Mountain Views Supervisory Union (member town: Pittsfield). Non-operating: tuitions all students.
Town of Pittsfield (official site; hosts the district's reports).

board.post_note: Pittsfield SD: three directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423, one elected each year at the annual school district meeting. One seat is held (see the source note).

sources.note: Pittsfield Annual Town & School District Report FY25 (official; published Jan. 2026): "2025 Elected Officials" lists Dubois exp 2028, Sperber exp 2027, Rice exp 2026; the March 4, 2025 school meeting minutes (pp. 11-12) record Peter Dubois elected to a three-year term. The board is three directors (16 V.S.A. section 423), one elected yearly. Raymond Rice's seat is HELD: his published term expired at the March 3, 2026 annual meeting and no return was fetched (resolving document: the March 3, 2026 school meeting minutes / FY26 town report). RESOLVED 2026-10-28: the March 3, 2026 school meeting minutes (see the minutes source) elect Jordan Stevens to the seat Rice's expired term left open; the board is now complete at 3 of 3 (Sperber 2027, Dubois 2028, Stevens 2029).

directors.name: Peter Dubois
directors.note: Elected March 4, 2025 (school meeting minutes in the FY25 report). The directors' report signs "Peter DuBois."

sources.note: Town of Pittsfield, Town Meeting Minutes page (official; the page Town Clerk Tricia Abbondelo pointed to in her 2026-10-27 reply to CivicMirror's records request): the Minutes of the Annual School Meeting, March 3, 2026 (recorded by the Town Clerk March 5, 2026; approved by the School Board and Moderator) -- Article 6, 'To elect a School Director for a three-year term': Jordan Stevens was nominated by Joyce Stevens, seconded by Kris Sperber; hearing no other nominations, nominations were closed and the voice vote was all in favor. Stevens is ELECTED to the three-year term, end '2029' (the minutes record the election by sole nomination + closure + unanimous voice vote rather than using the word 'elected'; no tally exists). Article 7 records thanks to Ray Rice for 18 years on the board -- Rice did not stand again; his seat is the one Stevens fills.
